description: Defines the DataObjects_Affiliates_extra class representing the 'affiliates_extra' database table, including properties, static methods, and audit-related functions.

classes.name: DataObjects_Affiliates_extra
classes.description: Represents the 'affiliates_extra' table with properties for each column, methods for audit and context management, and static retrieval.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Retrieves a static instance of the object based on key-value pair.

methods.name: sequenceKey
methods.description: Overrides sequence key handling; indicates no autoincrement/sequence.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID, here the affiliate ID.

methods.name: getOwningAccountIds
methods.description: Returns account IDs related to the affiliate for audit ownership, based on the 'affiliates' table.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit array specific to affiliates, setting 'key_desc' to an empty string.
